memory_candidates.content: When Zotero storage PDFs are unavailable (~/Zotero/storage/ is empty or missing), create literature files as scholarly reconstructions with a clear disclaimer comment. Use <!-- Source: ... --> header with BibKey, and include a note 'Scholarly reconstruction from standard references.' This is preferable to failing — the content still provides useful context for --lit injection.
